entities.summary: Joseph Reshard Crawford II is an American former professional basketball player. He played college basketball for the Kentucky Wildcats and was selected with the 58th overall pick by the Los Angeles Lakers in the 2008 NBA draft. He signed with the Lakers on August 27, 2008, but was waived October 22, during the 2008–09 pre-season.
